**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is considering upgrading the lighting in their kitchen.

[FACT] User has a kitchen with a lot of dark corners.

[EVENT] User replaced the LED bulb in their bedside lamp on February 10th.

[CHANGE] User has had a huge difference in lighting quality since replacing the bedside lamp bulb.

[PREFERENCE] User likes the idea of under-cabinet lighting.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested several types of lighting for the kitchen: recessed lighting, under-cabinet lighting, task lighting, LED strip lighting, pendant lighting, wall-mounted fixtures, layered lighting, motion-sensing lights, and consulting a professional.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended choosing LED bulbs with a warm white color temperature (2700K-3000K) for a cozy atmosphere.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of recommended LED bulbs for under-cabinet lighting: Philips LED Under Cabinet Lighting, GE Reveal LED Bulbs, LIFX LED Strip Lights, Sylvania Smart+ LED Bulbs, and Feit Electric LED Under Cabinet Lights.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised considering factors like color temperature, lumen output, dimmability, and certifications when selecting LED bulbs.

[PREFERENCE] User has been happy with the LED bulbs purchased from IKEA in the past.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that IKEA bulbs might work for under-cabinet lighting but advised checking lumen output, color temperature, beam angle, and certifications.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested that installing a dimmer switch for under-cabinet lighting could provide flexibility in brightness for different tasks and moods.

[PREFERENCE] User is considering installing a dimmer switch for their under-cabinet lighting.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided recommendations for finding a reliable electrician: word of mouth, online review sites like Yelp, Angie's List, HomeAdvisor, Thumbtack, Google Reviews, and Facebook Reviews.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant encouraged user to consult with a professional electrician to ensure safe and correct installation of the lighting.
